cards.name: A Display of My Dark Power

question: If I tap Gaea's Cradle for mana while I control no creatures, so it produces no mana, does the delayed triggered ability from A Display of My Dark Power still trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: No: if a land is tapped for mana but doesn't produce any, the delayed triggered ability won't trigger.
expected.answer: If a land is tapped for mana but doesn't produce any (for example, if you tap Gaea's Cradle for mana while you control no creatures), the delayed triggered ability won't trigger.
